title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 27
description: Ten questions on Genesis 27: how Jacob received the blessing Isaac meant for Esau, and what followed.

questions.text: What did Isaac ask Esau to bring him before he would bless him?
questions.explanation: Isaac told Esau to take his bow, go to the field, get venison and make him savory food, so that his soul might bless him.

questions.text: What did Rebekah tell Jacob to get from the flock?
questions.explanation: Rebekah said, "Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats," to make savory food for his father.

questions.text: Why was Jacob afraid his father would recognize him?
questions.explanation: Jacob said, "Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man. What if my father touches me?"

answers.text: Esau was hairy and Jacob was smooth
Esau had a much louder voice

questions.text: How did Rebekah answer Jacob's fear of bringing a curse on himself?
questions.explanation: His mother said to him, "Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice."

answers.text: "Let your curse be on me, my son."

questions.text: What did Rebekah put on Jacob's hands and neck?
questions.explanation: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands and on the smooth of his neck.

answers.text: The skins of the young goats

questions.text: How did Jacob explain finding the venison so quickly?
questions.explanation: Isaac asked how he found it so quickly, and he said, "Because Yahweh your God gave me success."

answers.text: A servant had helped him hunt
He had found it near the tents
His mother had kept it ready

questions.text: What did Isaac say after feeling Jacob?
questions.explanation: Jacob went near, and Isaac felt him and said, "The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau."

answers.text: "The voice is Esau's voice, but the hands are the hands of Jacob."
"The smell is Jacob's, but the voice is Esau's."
"The hands and the voice are Esau's."
"The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau."

questions.text: Which words were part of Isaac's blessing on Jacob?
questions.explanation: Isaac blessed Jacob with the dew of the sky and plenty of grain and wine, and said, "Be lord over your brothers."

answers.text: "You will shake his yoke from off your neck."

questions.text: What did Esau plan to do once the days of mourning for his father came?
questions.explanation: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing and said in his heart, "The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob."

answers.text: Leave for the land of Seir

questions.text: To whom did Rebekah tell Jacob to flee?
questions.explanation: Rebekah said, "Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran."
